Training

Boxing trains the whole body: fitness, strength, coordination and focus. You do not need any experience to start.

Training times

Get started

Four steps into the ring

Show up

Come 15 minutes before the session starts and we will show you around.

Try for free

Your first session is always free. No sign-up needed.

Borrow equipment

We have gloves and equipment you can borrow at the start.

Join

After your trial we will agree on fees and membership.

Practical

What should I bring?

You do not need much equipment to get started. This is a good start:

  • Training trousers and a t-shirt
  • Indoor shoes – we do not wear outdoor shoes in the gym
  • Water bottle
  • Towel
  • Your own gloves once you are settled in

Do not have equipment? You can borrow from us at the start.

Competition

Want to compete?

To compete you need a valid boxing licence and a medical certificate. We help you enter events and support you through the season.

The club takes part in recruit series, regional events and national championships – and hosts its own sparring events in Grimstad.

Talk to us

Questions

Anything you wonder about?

Do I need to be fit?

No. You start at your own pace and the coaches adapt the sessions to your level.

Can women train here?

Yes. Boxing suits women and men, girls and boys equally well.

Do I need my own equipment?

No, you can borrow gloves and equipment at the start. Later we recommend getting your own gloves.

Is boxing dangerous?

Boxing is a contact sport, but training is adapted to your level. Beginners start with technique and light drills – not hard sparring.

How much does it cost?

Your first session is free. Contact us for fees and membership.

Your first session is free

Just show up in training clothes – we will show you around and help you get started.
